import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/test_9.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes from each source
    dfs = []

    # Load each source CSV into a DataFrame
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Ensure columns are in the correct order and types as target schema
        df = df[['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige']]

        # Enforce data types according to target schema
        df = df.astype({
            'admit': 'int64',
            'gre': 'int64',
            'gpa': 'float64',
            'prestige': 'int64'
        })

        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source DataFrames into one target DataFrame
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Optional: If duplicates exist and should be removed, uncomment the next line
    # target_df = target_df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

    # Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_8/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
